description: This script contains functions for managing device upgrades on specific hardware, including checking partition layouts, performing upgrades by copying images to disks, and copying configuration backups. It appears to be part of a larger upgrade system tailored for a particular device setup.

methods.name: mbl_do_platform_check
methods.description: Checks if the current device's partition layout matches the expected layout in an upgrade image, and prompts for abort if it has changed.

methods.name: mbl_do_upgrade
methods.description: Executes a disk upgrade process by copying partition images, handling partition table changes, and writing a new UUID.

methods.name: mbl_copy_config
methods.description: Copies a backup configuration file to the device's partition.
